summary: WAYLOAM v0.3.1.alpha fixes Build route failures caused by temporary public-service errors and unsupported BRouter profile overrides.
highlights: Build route now falls back to a second BRouter service when the primary public router is unavailable or overloaded.
Place search falls back from OpenStreetMap Nominatim to Photon instead of failing the whole trip.
Bikepacking no longer sends an unsupported allow_steps profile override to BRouter.
added: Secondary BRouter backend fallback for route calculation.
Cleaner service-error handling for temporary HTTP failures and timeouts.
changed: Route-service errors now distinguish place-search problems from routing-service congestion.
Route-corridor POI lookup remains optional and can fail without losing the generated route.
fixed: Fixed Build route showing a retry-later/server error when a public OSM or BRouter service is temporarily busy.
Removed unsupported BRouter profile parameters from the default Bikepacking request.
Prevented a single public geocoder or routing endpoint from being a hard dependency for every route build.
